script: Saturn's rings are made of countless chunks of ice and rock. Some pieces are as small as dust, and others are as big as houses. Some scientists think the rings formed only a few hundred million years ago. They are also slowly raining down onto Saturn. In a few hundred million years, they could be mostly gone.
